summary: Session C2 (Projects, Planning, Time Tracking) tested end-to-end. Backend: 17/17 pytest tests pass (10 new HTTP integration tests + 7 pre-existing unit tests). Frontend: all critical flows for Projects (create, open drawer, add task), Planning (sprint create), Time Tracking (start/stop timer, manual entry, weekly timesheet) verified via Playwright. Regression on Finance/Sales/HR modules passes. Jury demo workspace correctly pre-seeded (5+ projects with totals matching spec, Sprint 12 present, 20+ tracked hours).

minor.issue: Returns {timer: null} / {timer: {...}} instead of null / bare timer as described in problem statement. Not a bug — frontend already consumes this shape correctly; adjust spec wording.
Requires JSON body ({} works). Frontend sends one, so no user-facing impact.
Requires full ProjectIn (name required) — no partial updates. Consider PATCH semantics if partial edits are ever needed.

issues: 4 stat pills render but individual pill data-testids (e.g. projects-stat-total) are not present — only projects-module wrapper testid exists. Consider adding per-pill testids for future automation.

action_items: Optional: add data-testid to individual stat pills (projects-stat-total/on_track/at_risk/completed) for finer-grained UI testing.
Optional: expose tt-export-csv-btn on the Weekly timesheet tab as well (currently only lives under Timer & entries tab) — spec text implies it should work while user is on the sheet view.
critical_code_review_comments: TimeTrackingModule.jsx (407 lines) and ProjectsModule.jsx / PlanningModule.jsx are approaching the 700-line splitting threshold — consider extracting Timer card, TimesheetTable, and Task picker into sub-components for maintainability.
server.py:3673 still uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') — migrate to FastAPI lifespan handlers.
Workspace isolation is enforced consistently across all 3 new modules via workspace_owner filter — good.
MongoDB _id correctly stripped in all list/detail endpoints (spot-checked projects_module, planning_module, time_tracking_module).
